title: "Machine Learning Comparison and Stacks Ensemble"
format: html
author: "Dionne Argyropoulos, Lauren Smith"
---

This document contains the step-by-step run through of creating a `workflowsets` machine learning comparison and a `stacks` ensemble. 

# Load Packages and Data 

We will load in pre-defined packages from `packages.R` and read in our data frame `d_samples_global_training.csv` containing 2,635 samples from the longitudinal cohort studies and negative control donor sources. 

```{r}
# Source R packages 
source(here::here("packages.R"))

# Load primary dataset
d <- read.csv(here::here("data/d_samples_global_training.csv")) %>% dplyr::select(-SampleID)

# Create list of PvSEMs
top_8   <- c("EBP", "PTEX150", "PvCSS", "LF005", "LF010", "RBP2b.P87", "LF016", "MSP8")

# Stable parameters
d_folds     <- vfold_cv(d, v = 10, repeats = 5, strata = status)
cores       <- parallel::detectCores() - 1

# Models to use 
models <- c(
  logistic_reg        = "logistic_reg",
  boost_tree          = "boost_tree",
  nearest_neighbor    = "nearest_neighbor",
  discrim_linear      = "discrim_linear",
  discrim_quad        = "discrim_quad",
  svm_linear          = "svm_linear",
  naive_bayes         = "naive_bayes",
  rand_forest         = "rand_forest"
)
```

# Compare multiple machine learning models 

## Step 1: Model specifications (pre-tuning)

```{r}
model_specs <- list(
  logistic_reg = logistic_reg() %>% set_engine("glm") %>% set_mode("classification"),
  boost_tree =
    boost_tree(
      tree_depth = tune(),
      learn_rate = tune(),
      loss_reduction = tune(),
      mtry = tune(),
      min_n = tune(),
      sample_size = tune(),
      trees = 10000
    ) %>%
    set_mode("classification") %>%
    set_engine("xgboost"),
  nearest_neighbor =
    nearest_neighbor(
      neighbors = tune(),
      dist_power = tune(),
      weight_func = tune()
    ) %>%
    set_mode("classification") %>%
    set_engine("kknn"),
  discrim_linear = discrim_linear() %>% set_mode("classification") %>% set_engine("MASS"),
  discrim_quad = discrim_quad() %>% set_mode("classification") %>% set_engine("MASS"),
  svm_linear =
    svm_linear(cost = tune(), margin = tune()) %>%
    set_mode("classification") %>%
    set_engine("kernlab"),
  naive_bayes =
    naive_Bayes(smoothness = tune(), Laplace = tune()) %>%
    set_mode("classification") %>%
    set_engine("naivebayes"),
  rand_forest =
    rand_forest(
      trees = 10000,
      mtry = tune(),
      min_n = tune()
    ) %>%
    set_mode("classification") %>%
    set_engine(
      "ranger",
      importance = "permutation",
      num.threads = cores,
      probability = TRUE,
      seed = 1234
    )
)
```

## Step 2: Workflow set

```{r}
log_recipe <- recipe(status ~., data = d) %>%
  step_log(all_predictors())

antibody_wkfl <- workflow_set(preproc = list(log = log_recipe), models = model_specs)
```

## Step 3A: Hyperparameter tuning 

```{r}
set.seed(1234)
grid_ctrl <- control_grid(
  save_pred = TRUE,
  parallel_over = "everything",
  save_workflow = TRUE
)

tuned_results <- antibody_wkfl %>%
  workflow_map(
    seed = 1234,
    resamples = d_folds,
    grid = 25,
    control = grid_ctrl
  )

saveRDS(tuned_results, here::here("model/all_tuned_model.rds"))
```

## Step 3B: Identify tuned hyperparameters & visualise best AUC per model

```{r}
# Best models
top_models <- tuned_results %>% 
  workflowsets::rank_results(select_best = TRUE) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(.metric == "roc_auc") %>% 
  dplyr::select(model, .config, roc_auc = mean, rank)
write.csv(top_models, here::here("model", "All_Models_Wkfl_Top_Rank_ROC_AUC.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# All models
all_models <- workflowsets::rank_results(tuned_results, rank_metric = "roc_auc")
write.csv(all_models, here::here("model", "All_Models_Wkfl_Rank_ROC_AUC.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Plot: rank vs AUC per model
auc_order <- tuned_results %>%
  workflowsets::rank_results(select_best = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.metric == "roc_auc") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(mean)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(model)

ranked_auc_plot <- tuned_results %>% 
  workflowsets::autoplot(metric = "roc_auc", select_best = TRUE) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
    breaks = auc_order,   # order legend by descending ROC AUC
    values = melb_trams(8, name = c("the1", "the70", "the109", "the30", "the19", "the12", "the58", "the48")),
    labels = c(
      "rand_forest" = "Random Forest",
      "boost_tree" = "XGBoost",
      "discrim_quad" = "QDA",
      "nearest_neighbor" = "k-Nearest Neighbours",
      "svm_linear" = "Support Vector Machine",
      "logistic_reg" = "Logistic Regression",
      "discrim_linear" = "LDA",
      "naive_Bayes" = "Naive Bayes"
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = 19, guide = "none") + 
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Model Rank",
    breaks = 1:8,
    limits = c(0.9, 8.1)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    name = "AUC",
    limits = c(0.82, 0.88),
    breaks = seq(0.82, 0.88, by = 0.02)
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::labs(color = "Model", y = "AUC")
# ggsave(here::here("model", "All_Models_Wkfl_Rank_ROC_AUC.png"), plot = ranked_auc_plot, width = 20, height = 15, units = "cm", dpi = 300)

ranked_auc_plot

# Top hyperparameters per model
top_hyperparams <- tuned_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(best = purrr::map(result, tune::select_best, metric = "roc_auc")) %>%
  dplyr::select(wflow_id, best) %>% 
  tidyr::unnest(cols = c(best)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!if_all(-c(wflow_id, .config), is.na)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(!c(wflow_id, .config), as.character)) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-c(wflow_id, .config), names_to = "Hyperparameter", values_to = "Values") %>% 
  tidyr::drop_na()
# write.csv(top_hyperparams, here::here("model", "All_Models_Wkfl_Top_Hyperparameters.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Step 4: Tuned model specifications & workflows

```{r}
# Extract best hyperparameters per model
hyperparams <- tuned_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(best = map(result, select_best, metric = "roc_auc")) %>%
  dplyr::select(wflow_id, best) %>% 
  tidyr::unnest(cols = c(best))

# Logistic Regression: no tuning parameters
logistic_reg_spec_tuned <- logistic_reg() %>%
  set_engine("glm") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

# Gradient Boosted Tree
boost_tree_spec_tuned <- boost_tree() %>%
  set_args(
    tree_depth = hyperparams %>% filter(wflow_id == "log_boost_tree") %>% pull(tree_depth), 
    learn_rate = hyperparams %>% filter(wflow_id == "log_boost_tree") %>% pull(learn_rate), 
    loss_reduction = hyperparams %>% filter(wflow_id == "log_boost_tree") %>% pull(loss_reduction), 
    mtry = hyperparams %>% filter(wflow_id == "log_boost_tree") %>% pull(mtry), 
    min_n = hyperparams %>% filter(wflow_id == "log_boost_tree") %>% pull(min_n), 
    sample_size = hyperparams %>% filter(wflow_id == "log_boost_tree") %>% pull(sample_size), 
    trees = 10000
  ) %>% 
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  set_engine("xgboost")

# k Nearest Neighbours
nearest_neighbor_spec_tuned <- nearest_neighbor() %>% 
  set_args(
    neighbors = hyperparams %>% filter(wflow_id == "log_nearest_neighbor") %>% pull(neighbors), 
    dist_power = hyperparams %>% filter(wflow_id == "log_nearest_neighbor") %>% pull(dist_power), 
    weight_func = hyperparams %>% filter(wflow_id == "log_nearest_neighbor") %>% pull(weight_func)
  ) %>% 
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  set_engine("kknn")

# Linear Discriminant Analysis: no tuning parameters
discrim_linear_spec_tuned <- discrim_linear() %>%
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  set_engine("MASS")

# Quadratic Discriminant Analysis: no tuning parameters
discrim_quad_spec_tuned <- discrim_quad() %>%
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  set_engine("MASS")

# Support Vector Machine
svm_linear_spec_tuned <- svm_linear() %>%
  set_args(
    cost = hyperparams %>% filter(wflow_id == "log_svm_linear") %>% pull(cost), 
    margin = hyperparams %>% filter(wflow_id == "log_svm_linear") %>% pull(margin)
  ) %>% 
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  set_engine("kernlab")

# Naive Bayes
naive_bayes_spec_tuned <- naive_Bayes(
  smoothness = hyperparams %>% filter(wflow_id == "log_naive_bayes") %>% pull(smoothness), 
  Laplace = hyperparams %>% filter(wflow_id == "log_naive_bayes") %>% pull(Laplace)
) %>%
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  set_engine("naivebayes")

# Random Forest: Keep fixed 10,000 trees
rand_forest_spec_tuned <- rand_forest() %>%
  set_args(
    trees = 10000,
    mtry = hyperparams %>% filter(wflow_id == "log_rand_forest") %>% pull(mtry),
    min_n = hyperparams %>% filter(wflow_id == "log_rand_forest") %>% pull(min_n)
  ) %>%
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  set_engine("ranger",
             importance = "permutation",
             num.threads = cores,
             probability = TRUE,
             seed = 1234) 

# Build tuned workflow set (matching the order of `models`)
model_specs_tuned <- list(
  logistic_reg = logistic_reg_spec_tuned,
  boost_tree = boost_tree_spec_tuned,
  nearest_neighbor = nearest_neighbor_spec_tuned,
  discrim_linear = discrim_linear_spec_tuned,
  discrim_quad = discrim_quad_spec_tuned,
  svm_linear = svm_linear_spec_tuned,
  naive_bayes = naive_bayes_spec_tuned,
  rand_forest = rand_forest_spec_tuned
)

antibody_wkfl_tuned <- workflow_set(preproc = list(log = log_recipe), models = model_specs_tuned)

# Resample tuned models
final_results <- antibody_wkfl_tuned %>%
  workflow_map(
    seed = 1234,
    resamples = d_folds,
    grid = 25,
    control = grid_ctrl
  )

saveRDS(final_results, here::here("model/all_final_model.rds"))
```

## Step 4 (continued): Collect predictions from tuned models

```{r}
# Collect assessment set predictions: unsummarised (per repeat) and summarised
all_preds_unsummarised <- final_results %>%
  collect_predictions(summarize = FALSE)
all_preds_summarised <- final_results %>%
  collect_predictions(summarize = TRUE)

# Plot ROC per model 
roc_plot <- all_preds_unsummarised %>%
  dplyr::group_by(model) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    model = factor(
      model, 
      levels = c("rand_forest", "boost_tree", "discrim_quad", "nearest_neighbor", "svm_linear", "logistic_reg", "discrim_linear", "naive_Bayes")
    )
  ) %>%
  yardstick::roc_curve(truth = status, .pred_new) %>%
  parsnip::autoplot() +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
    values = melb_trams(8, name = c("the1", "the70", "the109", "the30", "the19", "the12", "the58", "the48")),
    labels = c(
      "rand_forest" = "Random Forest",
      "logistic_reg" = "Logistic Regression",
      "svm_linear" = "Support Vector Machine",
      "boost_tree" = "XGBoost",
      "nearest_neighbor" = "k-Nearest Neighbours",
      "discrim_linear" = "LDA",
      "discrim_quad" = "QDA",
      "naive_Bayes" = "Naive Bayes"
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "1 - Specificity", y = "Sensitivity", colour = "Model")
roc_plot

# AUC per model
auc_results <- all_preds_summarised %>%
  dplyr::group_by(wflow_id) %>%
  yardstick::roc_auc(truth = status, .pred_new) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(wflow_id = gsub("log_", "", wflow_id)) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(.estimate))
write.csv(auc_results, here::here("model", "Top_Models_AUC.csv"))

auc_results
```

```{r}
# Join predictions to longitudinal cohort data
d_with_id <- d %>% dplyr::mutate(.row = row_number())

all_preds_summarised <- all_preds_summarised %>%
  dplyr::mutate(model = ifelse(model == "naive_Bayes", "naive_bayes", model))

preds_list <- all_preds_summarised %>%
  dplyr::group_by(model) %>%
  group_split(.keep = TRUE) %>%
  set_names(map_chr(., ~ unique(.x$model))) %>%
  map(~ .x %>%
        select(-status, -.config) %>% 
        left_join(d_with_id, by = ".row") %>%
        select(-.row)
  )

# Identify and save model-specific predictions and thresholds
for (model_type in unique(all_preds_summarised$model)){
  
  # Model-specific summarised predictions 
  wflow_specific_preds <- all_preds_summarised %>% 
    filter(model == model_type) %>% 
    roc_curve(status, .pred_new)
  
  # Find the maximised sensitivity/specificity
  threshold_max_sens_spec <- wflow_specific_preds$.threshold[which.min(abs(wflow_specific_preds$specificity - wflow_specific_preds$sensitivity))]
  # Find where the threshold is above a certain level of sensitivity
  wflow_ROC_sorted_sens <- wflow_specific_preds %>% arrange(desc(.threshold))
  threshold_85_sens <- wflow_ROC_sorted_sens$.threshold[which(wflow_ROC_sorted_sens$sensitivity >= 0.85)[1]]
  threshold_90_sens <- wflow_ROC_sorted_sens$.threshold[which(wflow_ROC_sorted_sens$sensitivity >= 0.9)[1]]
  threshold_95_sens <- wflow_ROC_sorted_sens$.threshold[which(wflow_ROC_sorted_sens$sensitivity >= 0.95)[1]]
  # Find where the threshold is above a certain level of specificity
  threshold_85_spec <- wflow_specific_preds$.threshold[which(wflow_specific_preds$specificity >= 0.85)[1]]
  threshold_90_spec <- wflow_specific_preds$.threshold[which(wflow_specific_preds$specificity >= 0.9)[1]]
  threshold_95_spec <- wflow_specific_preds$.threshold[which(wflow_specific_preds$specificity >= 0.95)[1]]
  # Save final threshold table (used as input for classifying on new data)
  threshold_table <- data.frame(
    sens_spec = c("max_sens_spec", "85_sens", "90_sens", "95_sens", "85_spec", "90_spec", "95_spec"),
    threshold = c(threshold_max_sens_spec, threshold_85_sens, threshold_90_sens, threshold_95_sens,
                  threshold_85_spec, threshold_90_spec, threshold_95_spec)
  )
  model_type_short <- gsub("log_", "", model_type)
  write.csv(threshold_table, here::here("model", model_type_short, paste0(model_type_short, "_threshold_values.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  
  # Add classifications given these thresholds
  model_results <- preds_list[[model_type]] %>% 
    mutate(
      .pred_class_threshold_max_sens_spec = as.factor(ifelse(.pred_new > threshold_max_sens_spec, "new", "old")), 
      .pred_class_threshold_85_sens = as.factor(ifelse(.pred_new > threshold_85_sens, "new", "old")), 
      .pred_class_threshold_90_sens = as.factor(ifelse(.pred_new > threshold_90_sens, "new", "old")), 
      .pred_class_threshold_95_sens = as.factor(ifelse(.pred_new > threshold_95_sens, "new", "old")), 
      .pred_class_threshold_85_spec = as.factor(ifelse(.pred_new > threshold_85_spec, "new", "old")), 
      .pred_class_threshold_90_spec = as.factor(ifelse(.pred_new > threshold_90_spec, "new", "old")), 
      .pred_class_threshold_95_spec = as.factor(ifelse(.pred_new > threshold_95_spec, "new", "old"))
    )
  
  # Evaluate metrics at each threshold
  antibody_metrics <- metric_set(roc_auc, sens, yardstick::spec, ppv, npv)
  sens_spec_performance_metrics <- bind_rows(
    model_results %>% antibody_metrics(truth = status, estimate = .pred_class_threshold_max_sens_spec, .pred_new) %>% mutate(group = "max_sens_spec"), 
    model_results %>% antibody_metrics(truth = status, estimate = .pred_class_threshold_85_sens, .pred_new) %>% mutate(group = "85_sens"), 
    model_results %>% antibody_metrics(truth = status, estimate = .pred_class_threshold_90_sens, .pred_new) %>% mutate(group = "90_sens"), 
    model_results %>% antibody_metrics(truth = status, estimate = .pred_class_threshold_95_sens, .pred_new) %>% mutate(group = "95_sens"),
    model_results %>% antibody_metrics(truth = status, estimate = .pred_class_threshold_85_spec, .pred_new) %>% mutate(group = "85_spec"), 
    model_results %>% antibody_metrics(truth = status, estimate = .pred_class_threshold_90_spec, .pred_new) %>% mutate(group = "90_spec"), 
    model_results %>% antibody_metrics(truth = status, estimate = .pred_class_threshold_95_spec, .pred_new) %>% mutate(group = "95_spec")
  )
  write.csv(sens_spec_performance_metrics, here::here("model", model_type_short, paste0(model_type_short, "_sens_spec_performance_metrics.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  
  # Confusion matrix at max sens/spec threshold
  max_sens_spec_confusion_matrix <- model_results %>% conf_mat(truth = status, estimate = .pred_class_threshold_max_sens_spec) 
  write.csv(as.data.frame(max_sens_spec_confusion_matrix$table), here::here("model", model_type_short, paste0(model_type_short, "_max_sens_spec_confusion_matrix.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Step 5: Fit and save final models

```{r}
wflow_ids <- antibody_wkfl_tuned$wflow_id
fitted_models <- map(wflow_ids, ~ {
  mod <- antibody_wkfl_tuned %>% extract_workflow(.x) %>% fit(d)
  dir <- here::here("model", sub("log_", "", .x))
  dir.create(dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  saveRDS(mod, file.path(dir, paste0(sub("log_", "", .x), "_final_model.rds")))
  mod
})
names(fitted_models) <- wflow_ids
```

# Stacks

## Step 1: Initialise, blend and fit stack

```{r}
# Initialise the stack, add candidate members, learn stacking
# coefficients (weights), then fit members with non-zero weights
fit_stack <- 
  stacks() %>% 
  add_candidates(final_results) %>% 
  blend_predictions() %>% 
  fit_members()

saveRDS(fit_stack, here::here("model", "stack", "stacked_model.rds"))
```

## Step 2: Evaluate stack and compare to individual ML models

```{r}
# Plot: Accuracy, Brier Class, Num_Members, ROC/AUC
options(scipen = 999)
stack_stats_plot <- fit_stack %>%
  stacks::autoplot() +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Penalty", y = "Mean") +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    ~ .metric,
    ncol = 1,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = as_labeller(
      c("accuracy" = "Accuracy", "brier_class" = "Brier Class", "num_members" = "Number of Contributing Models", "roc_auc" = "AUC")
    )
  )
ggsave(here::here("model", "stack/stack_stats.png"), plot = stack_stats_plot, width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm", dpi = 300)

stack_stats_plot
```

# Plot: Compare fit stack AUC to tuned single-model AUC

  dplyr::filter(.metric == "roc_auc") %>%
